claims.text: The FDA azathioprine label says rheumatoid arthritis patients previously treated with alkylating agents including chlorambucil may have a prohibitive malignancy risk if treated with azathioprine.
claims.quote: Patients with rheumatoid arthritis previously treated with alkylating agents (cyclophosphamide, chlorambucil, melphalan, or others) may have a prohibitive risk of malignancy if treated with azathioprine.

headline.text: The FDA azathioprine label lists prior chlorambucil treatment as a possible prohibitive malignancy risk (c1).

reported.text: The FDA azathioprine label says patients previously treated with alkylating agents, chlorambucil among them, may have a prohibitive risk of malignancy on azathioprine.

gaps.text: No controlled human study of this combination was found in the PubMed search.
